description: Metaschema for relation value schemas. A relation schema describes the valid values for the `value` field of a relation triple `(subject, relation, object)`. The schema URI is used as the `relation` field in the triple, allowing the node to look up and validate the value.

relationProperties.description: ODF-specific metadata for this relation schema.

subjectResourceTypes.description: List of resource type URIs that are valid subjects of this relation. When absent any resource type is allowed as subject.

objectResourceTypes.description: List of resource type URIs that are valid objects of this relation. When absent any resource type is allowed as object.
